text: The purpose of this report is to seek instruction for a Local Planning Appeal Tribunal appeal on the above-noted municipal addresses.

City Council authorize the public release of the confidential recommendations in Confidential Attachment 1 and Confidential Appendix A to the report (December 3, 2018) from the City Solicitor. 3. City Council direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (December 3, 2018) remain confidential.
